chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Jabir ibn 'Abdullah, who said:

Indeed, Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to him: 'These companions of ours refused to increase in their prayer during Ramadan, whereas the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) increased in his prayer during the month of Ramadan.'

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet increase his prayers during Ramadan?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the Sunnah of augmenting *Tahajjud* and other voluntary prayers specifically during Ramadan, contrasting the conservative stance of certain companions with the Prophet’s (PBUH) exemplary devotion. It serves as a foundational proof for the Shia practice of emphasizing night prayers in the month of fasting, reinforcing the spiritual elevation associated with the 'Month of God.'
